title: Rural Home Loans Escrow Account Terms by Product
content:
Escrow account terms of the Rural Home Loans products: the cushion, the handling of surpluses and shortages, and the escrow waiver figures.

## Terms defined

- **Cushion** — escrow cushion kept above the projected low point, in months of annual disbursements divided by 12 (at most one-sixth of the annual total).
- **Surplus refund minimum** — a surplus found at analysis of at least this amount is refunded when the loan is current; smaller surpluses are credited to the next year's deposits.
- **Shortage spread** — months over which an escrow shortage is spread unless the member pays it in a lump sum.
- **Surplus refund days** — calendar days after the analysis date by which a refundable surplus is paid.
- **Escrow waiver maximum loan-to-value** — escrow may be waived only when principal is at or below this percentage of the original value.
- **Escrow waiver fee percentage** — one-time fee for waiving escrow, percent of the principal balance.
- **Escrow waiver seasoning** — monthly payments that must have come due since closing before escrow may be waived.

## Table

| Product | Cushion (months) | Surplus refund minimum (USD) | Shortage spread (months) | Surplus refund days | Escrow waiver maximum LTV | Escrow waiver fee percentage | Escrow waiver seasoning (payments) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 30 | 80 percent | 0.25 | 12 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 30 | 80 percent | 0.25 | 12 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 30 | 80 percent | 0.25 | 12 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 30 | 80 percent | 0.25 | 12 |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 30 | 80 percent | 0.25 | 12 |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 30 | 80 percent | 0.25 | 12 |

## Reading the table

- A cushion of 2 months is two-twelfths, that is one-sixth, of the year's projected disbursements. *Hypothetical illustration:* with projected disbursements of 4800.00 USD for the year, a 2-month cushion is 800.00 USD.
- A surplus of exactly 50.00 USD meets the surplus refund minimum; a surplus of 49.99 USD does not.
